text: During the agent body build (T015). On the pilot's measurement that the user settings' effortLevel masked the agent's effort: "I just removed effort from global user settings. wrong place for it." On the pilot's claim that the cockpit CLAUDE.md is not loaded automatically: "No it doesn't, it loads auto anytime a file is read in the cockpit. what this means now that you have an agent body is that you will start reading files from that rather than the claude."
